evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses the same requirement or is substantially contained in this one.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the specific invite-via-URL requirement.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires starting a round via a single multi-line text field.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-focused view of current session items is not duplicated elsewhere (similar estimator view differs by actor).

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: This moderator action (selecting items for estimate or re-estimate) is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses the same add-item requirement.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing an item is distinct and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deletion of items is a distinct requirement not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: This moderator ability to show estimates early is unique and not duplicated by participant stories which require different timing.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average as the agreed estimate is a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Automatic filling on unanimous card is a specific behavior not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Explicit moderator entry of agreed estimate is distinct from other estimate-related stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained by PP-005 which already allows selecting an item to be re-estimated; no meaningful difference in actor or context.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing from a file is a specific mechanism not duplicated by the copy/paste story.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste as an entry method differs from importing; not the same requirement.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing games is distinct from viewing or exporting transcripts and is not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a game transcript is a unique requirement separate from browsing or exporting.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export-as-HTML is a specific format requirement not duplicated by other export or view stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export-as-CSV is a distinct requirement from HTML export or viewing.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game is a unique function not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is distinct from other account and game management stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login requirement is distinct and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Updating account details is unique among account management stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is a distinct requirement not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display requirement is unique in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is specific and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, ...} or {0, 1, 2, ...}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting the estimate scale is a distinct configurability requirement.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: This specific limit on invitations is not duplicated by other invite stories.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Estimator join-by-name requirement is distinct from moderator invite.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Estimator view of the current item is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Estimator's view of all session items differs by actor from moderator story PP-004.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Showing that an estimate has been given (without revealing value) is distinct from showing who gave what values.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Participant requirement to see all estimates simultaneously after all have voted is distinct from moderator early-show behavior.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Functionally the same permission as PP-041 (change estimate until draw completion); no meaningful difference in actor or context.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Request to view prior estimates per estimator is unique and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Seeing mapping of estimators to estimates during a round differs from merely seeing that someone has voted.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer start functionality is distinct from other timer/reset or related features.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset behavior is a specific timer requirement separate from starting the timer.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Participant ability to scroll prior rounds is distinct from moderator transcript/view/export features.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering consistency across draws is a unique UI requirement.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-034 which grants the same permission to change estimates until draw completion; no meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Personal thumbnail display is a unique UI personalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Specific standards compliance is a distinct developer requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing definitions is a unique documentation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Developer task to create indexes is a specific implementation requirement not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Support for specific browser versions is a unique compatibility requirement.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a distinct requirement, not duplicated by other dev stories.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/response requirement is unique and not duplicated by implementation tasks.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a unique internationalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design requirement is distinct and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page quality is a unique UX requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Data anonymization for research is a unique privacy requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics reporting for usage is a distinct requirement not duplicated elsewhere.
